title: Operation Save the Beagles
author: Tamara Bedic
content:
Some held white carnations. Others wore white Tyvek suits. Several hundred
waded through feces-filled moats to cluster at Ridglan’s gates and plead with
authorities. Their goal? To remove ~2000 beagles from wire cages stacked in
the windowless sheds of Ridglan Farms– a puppy mill 25 miles southwest of
Madison, WI that breeds thousands of beagles […]
